description: A mycelium tangle bounded by a circle — the master mark, its exploration sheet, and its first festival moment.
story: The brief: make biology feel engineered. Twelve directions were drawn — helixes, flasks, monograms — before the answer arrived from the organism itself: a mycelial network, clipped by a perfect circle, precise enough for a pharma label and alive enough for a festival post. The chrome stays neutral so one teal reads as the signal.

captions.azoth-master-mark.webp: The master mark — a mycelium network held in a circle.
captions.logo-explorations.webp: Twelve directions on one sheet — the route to the tangle.
captions.dusshera-campaign-post.webp: Dusshera, said in brand language: strike out your daemons.
